scope: Three deterministic original C templates with two difficulty tiers, finite complete input domains, actual Rust reference validation and candidate execution, temporary non-scoring practice only.

compatibility.oldEngines: All four original WASM bytes and original EXEC/STEP/DIAG protocols remain unchanged. Fifth WASM links the unchanged advanced interpreter library.
compatibility.newConsumer: Canonical closed bounded GEN1 requests, exact seed/template/problem/attempt/source identities, current Worker and original 1000ms deadline, original strict advanced trace decoder and full inverse state.
compatibility.learning: No catalog/course/exercise aliases, accepted learning credentials, events, rewards, achievement or weakness writes from generated practice.
compatibility.storage: SAVE9/DB9/17 stores unchanged; transient source and generated result discarded on refresh. Existing weakness service may independently refresh its source summary.
compatibility.privacy: Rust sees only knowledgeId, difficulty, seed, operation/request identity, plus current transient answer/source/input for grade or preview. No archive, summary, personal facts or model request.

replay: Original EXEC1.4/STEP1.3/DIAG1.3/INT1 with fifth build hash, exact source and input. Pure trace consumption; frontend computes no algorithm or expected answer.
fallback: Unconfirmed or unsupported weakness evidence is disclosed with links to original courses/review; default generic foundational practice never claims mastery or personalized model generation.
